name: Plate Neck Curl
steps: Lie faceup on a flat bench with your head clear of the edge and hold a light weight plate steadily against a towel on your forehead.
Stabilize the plate lightly with both hands without pulling it up or pressing it down.
Curl your chin smoothly toward your chest against the plate's load under strict control.
Lower your head slowly back to neutral while keeping constant light guidance on the plate.
tips: Start with very light weight and master bodyweight repetitions first before adding external load.
Use slow, deliberate repetitions and stop before fatigue compromises smooth neck control.
